meta_description: P.M. Plasterers in Birmingham. Expert internal & external plastering, rendering, and decorative finishes. Free quotes. Call 07751 853473.
hero_subhead: From cracked ceilings to full room replastering, we deliver smooth, professional finishes that last.
services_subhead: Whether you need patch repairs, full replastering, or decorative finishes, we handle every job with precision.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Replastering
services.desc: Complete internal walls and ceilings replastered to a smooth finish. Ideal for new builds, renovations, and older properties needing restoration.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Crack Filling
services.desc: Fast repairs for cracks, holes, and water damage. We assess the underlying cause and make repairs that won't crack again.

services.title: External Rendering & Pebbledash
services.desc: Weatherproof external finishes that protect your property and enhance kerb appeal. We use quality materials rated for UK weather.

services.title: Artexing & Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Textured ceiling and wall finishes for character and visual interest. Can also remove Artex safely where required.

services.title: Ceiling Repairs & Skimming
services.desc: Damaged or sagging ceilings brought back to flat perfection. Skim coats applied for a flawless paint-ready surface.

services.title: New Build & Commercial Plastering
services.desc: Large-scale projects handled on time and on budget. We work with builders, contractors, and property managers across the Midlands.

about_pullquote: We turn rough walls into beautiful surfaces that make your home feel brand new.
about_para_1: P.M. Plasterers was founded on the principle that plastering is both craft and trade. With nearly two decades in the business, we've replastered thousands of Birmingham homes—from Victorian terraces to new-build apartments. Every project, big or small, gets the same meticulous attention and quality materials.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we don't cut corners. We arrive on time, work cleanly, and finish to a standard that stands up to scrutiny. Your walls are your backdrop—we make sure they're flawless.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a water-damaged ceiling that needed replastering before we could decorate. P.M. Plasterers came out quickly, sorted it in a day, and the finish is absolutely smooth. Proper job. No mess left behind either.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on rendering the front of our 1950s semi. They explained exactly what needed doing and the price was fair. Took three days, looks brilliant now, and they pointed out a damp issue we'd missed. Top blokes.
reviews.author: Margaret K.

reviews.text: New plaster throughout the extension—seamless join to the old walls, perfectly finished. Their lad even helped work around our furniture without any fuss. Would use them again for sure.
reviews.author: James M.
